statement: Never spawn a subprocess per row and never do O(all sessions/conversations) work uncached on a path that scans ~/.claude/projects or session state; gate by candidacy, cache by (mtime, size), batch subprocess calls
rationale: Every "CCC is slow" incident traced back to the same bug: a user-facing path doing per-item subprocess forks (ps/lsof/gh/git) or full transcript re-parses, invisible at test scale (tiny fixtures) but seconds-plus in production with 1000+ transcripts. tests/test_perf_budget.py enforces this with call-count invariants, run by scripts/pre-push.sh before every push — if it fails, fix the call pattern, don't relax the bound.
